title: Building an AI-Driven Research Knowledge Graph for Problem Discovery and Organization

contributions.purpose: 提出以"研究问题"(而非论文)为一等对象的AI驱动知识图谱愿景
contributions.mechanism: LLM从论文抽取问题陈述/假设/约束/数据集/指标为节点,经语义+引用关系连边,支持问题导向查询与排序
contributions.evaluation: 无(纯提案,未实现,未做实验)
contributions.domain: 科研发现 / 学术知识图谱
contributions.source_quote: a vision for an AI-driven system that ingests research papers and transforms their content into structured, machine-navigable representations of open problems

contributions.purpose: 给出3个研究问题/假设与预期评测方案
contributions.mechanism: RQ1 抽取可靠性(vs人工标注)、RQ2 图+嵌入检索增益、RQ3 排序机制有用性;拟用~200篇软件工程论文
contributions.evaluation: 预期指标:precision/recall/F1、MRR、nDCG、用户研究(Likert、任务完成时间);均未执行
contributions.source_quote: HP1: With structured prompting, schema validation, and lightweight human-in-the-loop review, LLMs will achieve extraction performance (precision, recall, F1) within 10% of human annotator agreement levels
